card.name: Unit words just before "per hour/minute"
card.fires_on: The last word of a measurement unit right after a number, where "per" plus a time unit (hour, minute, second, day) is expected next, as in "60 miles per hour" or "20 beats per minute".

modes.label: Speed and rate units
modes.description: A unit word such as miles, beats or feet after a number, ahead of "per hour/minute/second".
modes.example: objects moving at 60<< miles>> per hour or faster

modes.label: Partial units and quantities
modes.description: Part of a compound unit, or a scale word like million, that leads into a rate over time.
modes.example: producing nearly 190<< million>> liters of fresh water a day

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "hour" (and its Chinese equivalents) as the time unit in a rate.
card.plain: It fires on the unit after a number when the phrase is heading toward "per hour" or "per minute".
